__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sands constantly shifting around you.
Rising out of the sand to the east you see a mighty pyramid.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Nothing but sand as far as the eye can see.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8700 to 8700

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The sands of the desert continue onward towards the pyramid.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8700 to 8701

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Nothing but sand as far as the eye can see.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8700 to 8700

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Across the hot burning sands you see a small oasis and some tents.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8700 to 5057

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The massive pyramid rises out of the sand, a monument to long-dead pharoahs.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Great Eastern Desert

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The mighty pyramid towers above you out of the hot desert sands, made from
huge blocks of stone that have been coated over with a rough sandy plaster-like
substance.  The face of the pyramid is steep, but you think you might be able
to climb it.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east you see the hot sands of the Great Eastern Desert.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8701 to 8700

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The steep slope of the pyramid rises up before you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8701 to 8702

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You wonder how anyone could have built such a massive thing out in this heat.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: At the Base of the Pyramid

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Hot air rises off the sides of the pyramid, and the wind chokes you with a
flurry of sand and dust.  So far you have made it halfway up the side.  The
walls of the pyramid are quite steep.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the northern side.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8702 to 8703

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the southern side.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8702 to 8704

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It looks too dangerous to try to climb any higher.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8702 to 8707

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Far below you are the burning sands of the desert.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8702 to 8701

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You wonder how anyone could have built such a massive thing out in this heat.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Climbing the Great Pyramid

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Hot air rises off the sides of the pyramid, and the wind chokes you with a
flurry of sand and dust.  The walls of the pyramid are quite steep, and you
are having trouble keeping from sliding down into the sands below.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the eastern side.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8703 to 8705

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the western side.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8703 to 8702

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It looks too dangerous to try to climb any higher.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8703 to 8707

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: This side of the pyramid has a dangerous drop before the sandy floor.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8703 to 8707

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You wonder how anyone could have built such a massive thing out in this heat.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Climbing the Great Pyramid

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here on the eastern side of the pyramid there is a little more shelter
from the heat and wind.  The stone side is not nearly so slippery smooth
from the ravages of time, and you think you may be able to even reach the
top from here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the northern side.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8705 to 8703

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: If you are daring you could try to skirt around to the southern side.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8705 to 8704

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the apex of the pyramid many yards above you.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8705 to 8706

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: This side of the pyramid has a dangerous drop before the sandy floor.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8705 to 8707

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You wonder how anyone could have built such a massive thing out in this heat.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Climbing the Great Pyramid

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Bathed in sweat, you have managed to reach the summit of the great pyramid.
The four sides of the pyramid slope sharply down into the hot sands in all four
cardinal directions.
   A plaque has been set into the sandy stones beneath your feet.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
The north side of the pyramid slopes down into the sands.
It looks really dangerous.  I wouldn't go that way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8706 to 8707

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The east side of the pyramid slopes down into the sands.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8706 to 8705

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
The south side of the pyramid slopes down into the sands.
It looks really dangerous.  I wouldn't go that way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8706 to 8707

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
The west side of the pyramid slopes down into the sands.
It looks really dangerous.  I wouldn't go that way.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8706 to 8707

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see some sandy stones pressed closely together to form a hard surface.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit stones 8706 to 8708

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The plaque reads:
This area (Great Pyramid) written by Andersen.

As you look closer you can make out a crack in the center of the stones
beneath your feet.  With some effort you might be able to lift that
section up and get inside!

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Apex of the Great Pyramid

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here the elements have carved away at the sides of the pyramid quite a
bit.  You aren't so sure of your footing anymore...

Suddenly the wind picks up, and you lose your balance!
You tumble down the side of the pyramid, and fall to your death!

SPLAT.
__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Climbing the Great Pyramid

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are climbing an ancient ladder that leads down into the depths of
the pyramid.  The air around is thick with layers of dust and a strange
musty smell.  Above you you see tiny beams of light coming through the
stones of the ceiling.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the sandy stones of the ceiling.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit stones 8708 to 8706

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small dusty chamber.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8708 to 8709

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
As you look closer you can make out a crack in the center of the stones
above your head.  With some effort you might be able to lift that
section up and get outside!

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Ladder

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing in a dank, musty chamber just inside the pyramid.
Footprints and other strange marks are set into the dusty floor here.
It would seem that some of the tenants of this monument are still alive.
   Exits lead in all directions.   The door to the west is covered with
inscriptions.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a tiny crawlway raised about three feet off the ground.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8709 to 8712

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A dust-covered hallway leads off to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8709 to 8739

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small crack in the wall through which you might be able to slide.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8709 to 8724

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a large stone door, covered in sigils and hieroglyphs.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door stone 8709 to 8710

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small rickety ladder leads up.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8709 to 8708

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
You cannot understand the strange glyphs that cover the door, but most of
them seem to depict scenes of fire and massive creatures of apparently
tremendous strength.  You have a feeling that the glyphs are serving as a
warning.

The stone door is covered in strange inscriptions and hieroglyphs that warn
you not to proceed any further.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Musty Chamber

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This room is dominated by a massive raised pool that is filled with
not water but flames of intense heat.  The multicoloured flames lick out
at you, searching for things to burn.
   The pool proceeds to the west into a small chamber.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a large stone door.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit door stone 8710 to 8709

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small chamber filled with fire.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8710 to 8711

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Fire Pool

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You make your way across the fire pool, and into a small stone chamber.
Here the flames are nearly as high as your head, singeing your face and
evaporating your sweat instantaneously.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The pool of fire ends to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8711 to 8710

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Chamber of the Efreet

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You have to go down onto your hands and knees to fit inside this tiny
space.  The crawlway is thick with sand and dust, and markings of the
passage of other creatures.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crawlway continues to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8712 to 8713

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crawlway ends to the south in a musty chamber.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8712 to 8709

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small hole above your head leads into a dank chamber.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8712 to 8737

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Tiny Crawlway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on your hands and knees, inside a small crawlway that winds
through the inside of the pyramid.  The crawlway is thick with sand, dust,
and markings of the passage of other creatures.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crawlway continues to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8713 to 8712

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crawlway continues to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8713 to 8714

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Tiny Crawlway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on your hands and knees, inside a small crawlway that winds
through the inside of the pyramid.  The crawlway is thick with sand, dust,
and markings of the passage of other creatures.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crawlway continues to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8714 to 8713

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crawlway gets a little tighter to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8714 to 8715

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Tiny Crawlway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here you are forced to slide on your belly through a particularly tight
section of the crawlway, as the stones of the pyramid close together
about you.  Below you is a small, slippery-looking hole that plummets into
blackness.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crawlway gets a little larger to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8715 to 8714

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crawlway continues to diminish in size to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8715 to 8716

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The hole looks very slippery and very dark.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8715 to 8717

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Tightening in the Crawlway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The crawlway shrinks away to nothing as the sandy stones of the pyramid
close together into a space through which only a snake could fit.   There is
barely enough space to turn around and make your way back through the tiny
crawlway to the north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crawlway gets a little larger to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8716 to 8715

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Crawlway's End

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The sides of this hole are slippery-smooth.  You lower yourself in, and
proceed to move downward... when suddenly you lose your purchase!

You fall for what seems like an eternity, and smash into the stones below...

Under the Hole
   You are in a small chamber underneath the slippery hole, far below
the pyramid now.   The floor is strewn with bones.  To the south is a
small rocky crevasse.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a rocky crevasse that proceeds deep under the pyramid.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8717 to 8719

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The bones have whitened and cracked in the dry air, apparently the remains
of adventurers, thieves, and creatures that did not survive the fall.
The hole looks far too slippery to climb back up.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Slippery Hole

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a small chamber underneath the slippery hole, far below
the pyramid now.   The floor is strewn with bones.  To the south is a
small rocky crevasse.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a rocky crevasse that proceeds deep under the pyramid.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8718 to 8719

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The bones have whitened and cracked in the dry air, apparently the remains
of adventurers, thieves, and creatures that did not survive the fall.
The hole looks far too slippery to climb back up.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Under the Hole

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are now exploring deep within a strange rocky crevasse that plunges
down into the rock on which the pyramid was constructed.  To the south you
see the flickering light of a fire, and the crevasse proceeds downward.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small stone chamber littered with bones.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8719 to 8718

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the flickering light of a small fire.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8719 to 8720

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The crevasse continues downward into total darkness.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8719 to 8721

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: As you look through the rough terrain, your eyes catch a small glint of light!

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Rough Crevasse

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here a small fire burns in a nook in the rocks, providing some warmth and
comforting light in the cold, dark, dry air.

Standing here is a strange-looking old man, who stares at you balefully.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a massive crevasse that plunges into darkness.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8720 to 8719

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The old man looks like he has been trapped down here far too long, and
has begun to lose his mind.  He moves about slowly, cackling to himself.

He turns to you and shouts, 'nope measse!  nope measse!', then turns
back and stares into the fire.

'What a strange person,' you think to yourself.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Small Fire

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The crevasse proceeds downward into the dark depths of the earth.
The air about you is now cold and quite dry, and your light source
gutters in a cool breeze that wafts up from below.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It is too dark for you to see any further along the crevasse.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8721 to 8719

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It is too dark for you to see any further along the crevasse.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8721 to 8722

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Down the Crevasse

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here the crevasse comes to an abrupt end.  A chilling wind howls
at your face from a black shape to the south, but the light from your
source is too dim to see exactly what it is.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a strange-looking black shape.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit sesame 8722 to 8723

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It is too dark for you to see anything along the crevasse.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8722 to 8721

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
You are now certain that the wind is the cold breath of some unearthly
giant animal, whose voice rumbles lowly on the breeze, and whose
massive jaws could easily swallow you whole.

You move closer for a better look, when suddenly a pair of eyes flashes.
A cold voice echoes: 'SEEK YE THE DIAMOND... IN THE ROUGH...'

... Then all is silent.

Wind howls about your ears like the roar of a tiger.  As your eyes
adjust to the light the shape to the south almost seems to take the
form of a massive animal head.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: At the Crevasse's End

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The jaws of the massive stone tiger part wide to reveal a great vault.
An arched ceiling lies far above your head... and all about you is a low
guttural rumbling noise and a chill wind.

Giant heaps of ancient treasure, gold coins, and valuables surround you
on all sides.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Through the jaws of the tiger you see the blackness of the crevasse.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8723 to 8722

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
You reach for some of the tasty goodies, when you hear a loud rumbling
sound and see a bright flash of light...

Then the words: 'TAKE ONLY THE LAMP... TOUCH NOTHING ELSE.'

... All is silent once again.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Vault of the Lamp

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You exhale, and squeeze yourself into the narrow crack in the wall.
Dust fills your eyes as you disturb it, and chunks of mortar and stone
mixed with a touch of sand fall on you as you scrape your way through.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a musty chamber.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8724 to 8709

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a tomb.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8724 to 8725

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Crack in the Wall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The floor of this small tomb is littered with the lids of
smashed sarcophagi, bits of treasure dropped by thieves and
looters, and corpses pulled from their resting places.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small crack in the wall through which you might be able to slide.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8725 to 8724

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east is another tomb.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8725 to 8733

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the west is another tomb.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8725 to 8726

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Looted Tomb

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This tomb has been utterly destroyed by thieves and looters in search of
the treasures of the pharoahs.  Nothing of interest remains in this room,
except a large stone coffin that leans against the western wall.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east is another tomb.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8726 to 8725

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a large stone coffin.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit coffin lid 8726 to 8727

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
As you look closer at the figure sculpted into the stone coffin you notice a
small marking carved into its chest.  It looks like a scarab or small beetle
would fit into the small space, if properly sized.

Hmm.

The coffin is sculpted into the form of a man, standing several heads above
you, and clad in the garments of pharoahs.  It has apparently been untouched
by the ravages of time and the activities of looters.  Several markings on the
side indicate spots where unsuccessful attempts were made to open the coffin.

You can't see any way to open it.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Demolished Tomb

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand now at the head of a stairway that goes down into darkness.
The steps and walls are smooth sandy stone, covered with a thick layer
of dust.  Some inscriptions are carved into the wall here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the backside of the coffin lid, featureless stone.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit coffin lid 8727 to 8726

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It is too dark to see down the stairway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8727 to 8728

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: On this side the coffin lid is smooth featureless stone.

You blow dust away from the inscriptions to read:
'Beware the curse of the mummy.'

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Stairway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are on a stairway that disappears into darkness in both directions.
The smooth, uneven steps of the stairway have not been travelled in what
appears to be centuries.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It is too dark to see up the stairway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8728 to 8727

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It is too dark to see down the stairway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8728 to 8729

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Stairway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand now at the base of the uneven stairway.  The walls, floor,
and ceiling of this small landing are covered with strange hieroglyphics.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a seam in the stone wall.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit stone 8729 to 8730

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: It is too dark to see up the stairway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8729 to 8728

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The hieroglyphics are covered with a thick layer of dust.  You clear the
dust away with your hand, and find that you cannot comprehend them.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Stairway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here the air is deathly still, motes of dust thickly obscuring your
vision.  Several stone statues line the walls of the hall, depicting the
gods of an ancient society.  Strange glyphs and sigils cover the walls, a
peculiar pictorial form of written language that you don't understand.
   Some steps lead to a raised dais to the south.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a seam in the stone wall.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit stone 8730 to 8729

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small raised dais.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8730 to 8731

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You don't understand the meaning of these symbols.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Ancient Hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are at the southern end of the ancient hall, the dust and darkness
absorbing your light so that you cannot see past the steps of the dais.
A low pedestal rests here.  You see something written into the face of it.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You cannot see past the steps of the dais.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8731 to 8730

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a seam in the stone floor.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit tomb 8731 to 8732

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The writings are covered in sand and worn nearly away by the passage
of time: 'I am Ramses the Damned, once counselor and aide to the mightiest
of pharoahs and queens of this land.  Much time has passed since I last
walked the earth.  Disturb my rest at your peril.'

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Raised Dais

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: You stand in an empty tomb, a cubicle no more then ten feet to a side.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: That leads back the way you came.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit tomb 8732 to 8731

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Tomb of Ramses

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This tomb has been completely ransacked and destroyed by the actions
of pyramid thieves and looters.  The floor is littered with junk.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the east is a low-ceilinged tunnel.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8733 to 8734

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: To the west is another tomb.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8733 to 8725

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Ransacked Tomb

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description: The low-ceilinged tunnel runs east-west.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You cannot see into the darkness of the low tunnel.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8734 to 8735

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a tomb.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8734 to 8733

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Here the tunnel forks off through a gaping hole down in the
southern wall, continuing onward to the east and west as well.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You cannot see into the darkness of the low tunnel.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8735 to 8736

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You cannot see into the darkness of the low tunnel.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8735 to 8734

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: Through the hole you see rubble and sand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8735 to 8746

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The hole is low, at the floor of the southern wall.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Fork in the Tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The low-ceilinged tunnel makes a turn to the west and ends
to the north as it spills out into a dusty hallway.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The mouth of the tunnel is stone that has been torn away by looters.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8736 to 8742

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You cannot see into the darkness of the low tunnel.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8736 to 8735

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Tunnel

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This chamber has a dank, dusty, musty smell to it.  Small footprints
in the dust betray the recent passage of some sort of creatures.  A hole
in the floor lies to the west and a stairway is to the east.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a spiral stone stairway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8737 to 8738

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see only blackness through the hole in the floor.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8737 to 8712

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Dank Chamber

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Some dusty, broken stone stairs here spiral slowly in a constricted
space down towards a dusty hallway.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The stairs spiral up into a dank chamber.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8738 to 8737

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The stairs spiral down into a dusty hallway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8738 to 8741

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Spiral Stairway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This hallway is covered with dust that has accumulated over the
centuries that the pyramid has stood.  Small markings and footprints
in the dust betray the recent passage of others -- perhaps thieves?

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The hallway proceeds to the east towards a strange smell.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8739 to 8740

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The hallway proceeds towards the west towards a musty smell.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8739 to 8709

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Dust-Covered Hallway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This small chamber has a sickly putrescent smell to it, the
smell of formaldehyde and other ointments used to preserve the
corpses of those who died ages ago.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a dusty hallway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8740 to 8741

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You a dusty hallway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8740 to 8739

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Smelly Chamber

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This hallway is covered with a thick, choking dust that rises
up to obscure your light source and sting your eyes.  Small marks
and footprints in the dust betray the recent passage of others.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The hallway turns to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8741 to 8742

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You smell something peculiar over there.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8741 to 8740

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A tightly spiralling stone stairway leads up.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8741 to 8738

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Dust-Covered Hallway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are standing in an elbow turn in a dust-covered stone hallway,
that dead ends to the north and continues on to the west.  To the south
the stones of the pyramid have been torn asunder by thieves, making
a low-ceilinged tunnel.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The hallway ends to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8742 to 8743

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The tunnel is dark.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8742 to 8736

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The dust-covered hallway continues to the west.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8742 to 8741

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Turn in the Hallway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The dust-covered hallway has come to an abrupt end at a stony,
featureless wall.  Here and there are signs of the recent passage
of others in the dust.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The dusty hall continues to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8743 to 8742

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The floor is quite dusty, and made of stone.  You see some cracks.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit floor 8743 to 8744

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The cracks look like you might be able to pull away some pieces of
the floor, perhaps even fit your body through the space you make.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Dead End

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are in a small, dark chamber that has stood undisturbed for
many years.  To the north stands a massive stone tomb, which is
covered in hieroglyphics and gold-lined carvings that mark it as the
final resting place of the mighty pharoahs of this land.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see the tomb of the pharoahs.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit tomb 8744 to 8745

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The stone ceiling has some cracks in it, through which a dim light streams.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit ceiling 8744 to 8743

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The markings indicate that this tomb is indeed the tomb of the greatest
pharoahs of the ancient civilization that built this massive pyramid.

The tomb looks like it has stood for many years, much like the pyramid
which encloses it.  It is covered in small hieroglyphics.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Tomb Entrance

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Great golden sarcophogai line the walls of this massive tomb.  It has
withstood the passage of time intact, untouched by the hands of thieves
and looters.  The treasures taken by the pharoahs to their graves still
lie before your feet.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: That way leads back out of the tomb.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit tomb 8745 to 8744

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The treasures are dusty and fragile, but still seem quite valuable.
You decide not to take them out of respect for the ancient dead.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: The Tomb of the Pharoahs

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This hallway formerly had a beautiful arch to the ceiling, now
collapsed under the weight of the slowly settling stones of the
pyramid.  Now, a massive pile of rubble leads up into a hole high
in the northern portion of the hallway.  To the south, through the
rubble and fallen stones you see a sandstone crypt.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a sandstone crypt.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8746 to 8747

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: >From here you see only darkness.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8746 to 8735

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Rubble-Strewn Hallway

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This small crypt is lit by a hole in the wall to the south, through
which sand pours from the desert outside.  A hot wind blows in from the
desert, drying your skin instantly.  To the east and north the arched
hallway continues.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The arched hallway collapses into rubble shortly to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8747 to 8746

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a beautifully arched hallway.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8747 to 8748

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a lot of sand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8747 to 8753

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Sandstone Crypt

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This hallway has a beautiful arch to it, formed painstakingly and
exquisitely out of the sandy stones of the pyramid.  The dust that
covers most of the rest of the pyramid interior is not present here,
scoured away by the blowing of the desert winds that howl about
your ears.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The arched hall proceeds to the east, making a sharp southward turn.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8748 to 8749

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The arched hall proceeds into a sandstone crypt.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8748 to 8747

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: An Arched Hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This hallway has a beautiful arch to it, formed painstakingly and
exquisitely out of the sandy stones of the pyramid.  To the east is
a small, golden-coloured crypt, and the hall proceeds to the south
and north.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The arched hall proceeds to the north, making a sharp westward turn.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8749 to 8748

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: A small golden crypt lies to the east.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8749 to 8750

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The arched hall proceeds to the south.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8749 to 8751

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: An Arched Hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand inside a small crypt with walls and ceiling made of
golden bricks that obscure the large sandy stones of the pyramid.
Small rugs and tapestries are scattered about the floor here, and
they appear to have been used recently.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see an arched hall.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8750 to 8749

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The small golden bricks are very smooth and also quite soft.

The rugs and tapestries are very fine and worn with age, their colors
now faded.  They depict scenes of life in an ancient desert city.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Golden Crypt

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
This hallway has a beautiful arch to it, formed painstakingly and
exquisitely out of the sandy stones of the pyramid.  The arched
hall proceeds to the north and ends to the south in a small vault.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: The arched hall continues to the north.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8751 to 8749

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small vault from which a shining light issues.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8751 to 8752

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: An Arched Hall

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
The stones of the pyramid here take on a strange, twinkling quality,
almost seeming to shine with an internal light.  As you look closer you
see tiny glass-like glittery particles within the stones, that reflect
the light from your light source so perfectly that they seem to shine.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a hall with a beautifully arched ceiling.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8752 to 8751

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The glassy particles reflect and refract your light source in a myriad
of dazzling colours that dance across your eyes and make you giggle.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Shining Vault

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You stand now on a massive sand dune on the southern side of
the pyramid.  At the foot of the sand dune to the north you see a
small hole where the stones of the pyramid have collapsed.  Not
far to the south is a massive roiling sandstorm; the wind from the
storm howls and bites at your face even here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a small hole leading back into the pyramid.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8753 to 8747

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8753 to 8754

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The sand is very white, and very sandy.  There sure is a lot of it.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Massive Sand Dune

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You are caught in the midst of a massive sandstorm.  Howling winds
buffet you from all sides, and the sand tears at your skin, blinding
you and choking you.  You have lost all sense of direction.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8754 to 8753

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8754 to 8754

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8754 to 8755

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8754 to 8754

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
Sand is about all you CAN see right now.  Unfortunately, it isn't very
interesting sand, only white, dry, and blowing all over the place.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Swirling Sandstorm

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
Somehow you managed to make your way through the howling winds
of the sandstorm, and clamber up on this sand dune.  You can see the
storm to the north of you, and presumably the pyramid is somewhere
beyond it.  Nothing but flat, featureless, open dunes of sand lie in
every other direction.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see only a wall of whirling, blowing, dry sand.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8758 to 8757

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description:
On the southern side of the sand dune is a small hole in the sand.
For some reason you seem unable to get to it.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit riddle 8758 to 8759

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
Like most of the ancient hieroglyphics of this land, the symbols are
totally incomprehensible to you.  Perhaps the Sphinx has the answer
to this ancient riddle.
A vision forms before your eyes, in glowing hieroglyphic symbols.
The sand is very white, and very sandy.  There sure is a lot of it.

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: A Massive Sand Dune

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.description:
You squeeze through the small hole in the sand and land in a small
white chamber.  Above you is a small hole, reachable by climbing up
the small sandy slope down which you slid.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.description: You see a sand dune.
__class__/rom24.world_classes.Exit.name: Exit  8759 to 8753

__class__/rom24.handler_room.Room.name: Through the Hole in the Sand
